baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَوَلَّىٰ ... وَقَالَ ... وَٱبْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ ... فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: Withdrawal closes the human audience, the spoken lament vents one measured portion, and the remaining grief is held until the eye becomes its visible surface. Speech and suppression are therefore two outlets of one pressure system, not a contradiction.

activation_trace.role: The withdrawal branch supplies the social closure that makes the grief partly private.
The voiced-speech branch makes the lament a controlled release rather than total silence.
The loss-and-yearning branch supplies the pressure generated by Yusuf's felt absence.
The whitening branch makes inward grief legible on an outward bodily surface.
The seeing-eye branch locates the bodily inscription in the organ that normally verifies presence.
The branch of inward roughening by grief supplies the affective load.
The held-breath and silence branch closes most of the outlet while allowing the single lament.
The sealed-after-filling branch supplies the pressure-vessel mechanism for what remains unspoken.

changed_reading.before: An elderly father becomes blind from sadness and then stays silent.
changed_reading.after: He manages grief as controlled pressure: he withdraws from the sons, lets one lament escape, and carries the unreleased remainder visibly in his eyes.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ ... عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ ... عَيْنَاهُ ... كَظِيمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: The turning root holds both proximity and withdrawal. He increases spatial distance from the present sons while the named absent son remains under inward attention; the binding branch of containment keeps this relation joined despite separation.

activation_trace.role: The proximity-without-gap branch keeps latent closeness active inside the act of turning.
The withdrawal branch supplies the opposite spatial motion whose relational meaning is being tested.
The eye-as-care branch converts failed sight into continuing inward guardianship of the absent son.
The binding-of-ends branch supplies a held connection across physical separation.

changed_reading.before: Turning away is disengagement from the family scene.
changed_reading.after: The outward turn redistributes attachment: distance from the speakers intensifies inward proximity, care, and binding to Yusuf.

baseline_models.mechanism: The lament root permits yearning grief and anger, while the final root specifically holds anger in the interior. The scene can therefore carry grief mixed with restrained protest toward the sons, the situation, or the self without selecting one target.

activation_trace.role: The anger-with-yearning branch keeps protest live inside the explicit lament.
The inward-grief branch prevents the anger activation from replacing sorrow.
The held-anger branch supplies restraint and explains why no accusatory outburst follows.
Withdrawal gives the mixed affect a nonconfrontational direction.

changed_reading.after: Its sorrow may contain restrained anger or protest, held away from direct accusation and left without a fixed human target.

context_deltas.mechanism: Yusuf earlier hides speech inside himself and does not bring it outward; Yaqub later turns aside, voices only a lament, and remains full of held affect. Separation is thus crossed by a father-son rhyme of protected interior speech.

activation_trace.role: The focus utterance marks the small portion of Yaqub's interior that reaches speech.
The held-interior branch anchors Yaqub's side of the concealment rhyme.
The literal hiding-inward branch supplies Yusuf's matching act of concealment.
The branch of what resides in the inner self supplies the chamber in which Yusuf keeps the saying.
The emergence branch, negated at its source, marks the disclosure Yusuf withholds.

structural_cues: 12:77 places concealment, interior self, and negated disclosure in one clause; 12:84 repeats speech plus withholding around the separated father and son.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two distinct acts of inward keeping; I infer a narrative rhyme across separation, while the live alternative is that they are unrelated instances of self-control.

changed_reading.before: Yaqub's containment is an isolated personal response.
changed_reading.after: His containment mirrors Yusuf's earlier protected inner speech, making concealed expression a bond shared by the separated pair.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is bracketed by lost hope attributed elsewhere, self-restraint oriented toward gathering the scattered, and a later command to track news without cutting off hope of relief. Yaqub's grief is severe but remains attached to return and action.

activation_trace.role: The loss-and-yearning branch anchors the severity that must not be diluted into optimism.
Held breath and silence make hope a sustained discipline rather than cheerful affect.
The cut-off-hope branch names the state reached by the brothers and provides a nearby contrast.
The holding-self-from-panic branch supplies the temporal discipline immediately preceding the focus.
The gathering-of-the-scattered branch gives restraint a concrete reunion horizon.
The twice-negated cut-off-hope branch defines the boundary that Yaqub places around grief.
The tracking-news branch converts sustained attachment into delegated search.
The relief-and-rest branch supplies the expected opening toward which the search moves.

structural_cues: 12:83 anticipates the gathering of all immediately before the focus.
12:87 turns the same loss into a command to search and repeats the prohibition of despair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hope, restraint, gathering, search, and relief around the focus; I infer that grief preserves agency, while the live alternative is that grief and hope merely coexist without a causal link.

changed_reading.before: Whitened eyes and contained grief signal a collapse into hopelessness.
changed_reading.after: The bodily collapse coexists with disciplined expectation: grief keeps the absent son present enough to sustain reunion-oriented search.

context_deltas.mechanism: Containment is audience-specific, not absolute. Yaqub closes himself to the sons' audience, then routes complaint toward God and disperses what was hidden from the self into that address.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal marks the human audience from whom fuller disclosure is withheld.
The sealed full outlet supplies the initial state that later receives a directed release.
The open-expression-of-complaint branch identifies the chosen mode of release.
The bringing-out of what was hidden in the self supplies the valve opening.

structural_cues: 12:84 turns away from them; 12:86 explicitly gives the complaint a different destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal, sealing, complaint, and disclosure of the inwardly hidden; I infer audience routing, while the live alternative is simply an increase in disclosure over successive speech.

changed_reading.before: KAZIM means that Yaqub does not express grief.
changed_reading.after: He regulates where grief may go: compressed before the sons, briefly audible in lament, and openly dispersed in address to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nearby claims distinguish witnessed knowledge from what is hidden from eyes, while Yaqub later claims knowledge unavailable to the sons. His whitening eyes can therefore dramatize a split: ordinary visual verification fails, but care and nonvisual knowing remain active.

activation_trace.role: Whitening supplies the visible impairment around which the epistemic reversal forms.
The seeing-eye branch anchors the loss of ordinary visual verification.
The eye-as-care branch keeps attentive guardianship live when physical sight weakens.
Presence-with-seeing supplies the limited evidentiary mode claimed by the sons.
The hidden-from-eyes branch names what their visual witness cannot reach.
The branch of something kept fixed in the self sharpens the contrast with their denied guardianship of the unseen.
The disclosure-to-the-knower branch supplies Yaqub's asserted knowledge beyond what the sons know.

structural_cues: 12:81 limits testimony to what was known and disclaims custody of the unseen.
12:86 contrasts Yaqub's knowledge with the sons' lack of knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies impaired eyes and an explicit knowledge asymmetry; I infer a sight-versus-insight contrast, while the live alternative is that Yaqub's knowledge claim is theological confidence unrelated to his eyes.

changed_reading.before: The whitened eyes are only a sensory deficit caused by grief.
changed_reading.after: Their failed sight exposes the limits of visible evidence while inward care and confident knowing persist beyond what the sighted sons can verify.

context_deltas.mechanism: A material trace of the absent son is cast onto the father's face and seeing returns. This makes the focus whitening reversible and relationally indexed: separation is written on the eyes, and renewed contact reverses the inscription.

activation_trace.role: The whitening branch supplies the separation-mark that later contact reverses.
The seeing organ anchors both the impairment and the later recovery.
The worn shirt supplies the material carrier of Yusuf's absent presence.
The casting branch supplies the directed transfer that brings the carrier into contact.
The face-and-facing branch supplies the bodily interface where renewed relation acts.
The ocular-seeing branch supplies the explicit reversal of the focus impairment.

structural_cues: 12:93 gives a direct sequence of shirt, casting, face contact, and restored seeing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the restorative contact sequence; I infer that the earlier whitening registers relation as well as pathology, while the live alternative is an ordinary physical cure whose symbolism need not govern 12:84.

changed_reading.before: The eye change is terminal bodily damage within the grief scene.
changed_reading.after: It is a reversible bodily register of separation, awaiting a material reconnection with Yusuf that restores sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sons describe continuing recollection as a path toward wasting and exhausted life. Their forecast turns the focus from a single emotional shock into a feedback loop: Yusuf is repeatedly brought to mind and tongue, and repetition is progressively inscribed in the body.

activation_trace.role: Voiced speech makes the remembered name recur outwardly rather than remaining a silent image.
Whitening supplies the already visible bodily accumulation of repeated grief.
The bringing-again-to-mind branch supplies the recurrent input to the loop.
The melting-at-the-edge-of-ruin branch supplies progressive bodily erosion.
The exhaustion-of-effort branch supplies the loop's feared endpoint without requiring immediate death.

structural_cues: 12:85 links continued remembrance to two successive bodily endpoints immediately after the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sons' causal forecast and the focus supplies an existing bodily change; I infer cumulative repetition, while the live alternative is that their statement is impatient exaggeration rather than reliable diagnosis.

changed_reading.before: The eyes whiten in one acute episode of sorrow.
changed_reading.after: The verse can freeze one moment in a chronic remembrance-body loop whose repeated naming slowly consumes bodily capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later movement from impulsive ignorance through patience to no reproach, covering of fault, and mercy retrospectively gives held anger an ethical trajectory. The focus may preserve anger without letting it become retaliation, leaving the family relation available for repair.

activation_trace.role: The anger-with-yearning branch supplies the potentially retaliatory charge.
The holding-anger branch prevents that charge from becoming direct attack.
The branch of disturbed impulse frames the brothers' earlier action as dysregulated rather than a permanent identity.
The restraint-from-panic branch supplies the ethical continuity between endurance and repaired relation.
The blame-for-fault branch, explicitly negated at source, supplies nonretaliation.
The covering of fault and protection from its effect supplies a reparative outcome.
The tenderness-and-mercy branch supplies the alternative destination of restrained anger.

structural_cues: 12:89-92 moves from naming ignorance to patience, then to negated reproach, forgiveness, and mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later family resolution voiced by Yusuf, not Yaqub; I infer a retrospective ethical trajectory for Yaqub's restraint, while the live alternative is that his containment has no causal relation to Yusuf's later mercy.

changed_reading.before: Suppressed anger is merely affect trapped inside Yaqub.
changed_reading.after: It may be affect ethically prevented from becoming retaliation, preserving the damaged relation for a later economy of no reproach and mercy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links non-ocular material branches into a hydraulic analogy, not a medical claim. It remains valid as a focus-rooted mechanism joining whitening, eye, and containment; downstream prose should use 'as if' language and must not present it as the lexical meaning or physiology of the verse.

activation_trace.role: The vessel-filling-or-emptying branch makes whitening materially ambiguous between saturation and depletion.
The running-spring branch recasts the eyes as sources of flow.
The aperture-in-a-waterskin branch supplies an outlet that can leak or be stopped.
The sealing of a filled outlet supplies blockage and retained pressure.
The water-holding channel branch supplies a hidden route through which grief-flow is stored or redirected.

changed_reading.before: Grief directly causes a static white impairment.
changed_reading.after: The eyes can be imagined as springs or vessels under a sealed hydraulic load, with whitening as the residue of flow held, diverted, or exhausted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a form-distant poetic activation: the patience branch's white accumulated cloud is not a proposed translation of SABR or of the whitened eyes. It remains anchored through the focus whiteness, eye-cloud, and water-channel branches; downstream prose should mark it as an image of accumulated patience holding future tears or relief.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَٱبْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ ٱلْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ

activation_trace.role: Literal whiteness supplies the visible color shared with the activated patience-cloud image.
The eye-cloud-and-rain branch places stored weather directly inside the focus eye.
The water-holding channel branch lets the cloud image function as retained rather than discharged grief.
The literal white accumulated cloud branch supplies a surprising material image for patience gathered immediately before the focus.

changed_reading.before: The eyes' whiteness records only damage from grief.
changed_reading.after: Whiteness can also appear, poetically and provisionally, as patience accumulated like a white cloud over the eyes, holding rain until release and reunion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the context occurrence of QWM means a people, while its cited branch images an eye still present after sight departs. The branch remains worth carrying because it precisely matches the focus impairment and the same ayah delegates sensory search to the group; downstream prose must present distributed perception as an analogy, never translate QAWM as eye.

activation_trace.role: The literal seeing organ anchors the eye whose capacity has failed.
Whitening supplies the visible mark of sight's departure.
The tracking-news branch transfers perceptual work from Yaqub's eyes to his sons' search.
The branch's literal image of an eye still standing with sight gone mirrors the focus and lets the surrounding people function as distributed perception.

changed_reading.before: Loss of sight leaves Yaqub only passive and perceptually cut off.
changed_reading.after: The eye remains while its seeing function is distributed outward: the father holds the absent relation, and the group is sent to sense and track on his behalf.

strongest_changes: Containment changed from mute repression into selective routing: one lament reaches the sons, fuller complaint is directed to God, and Yusuf supplies an earlier mirror of inwardly protected speech.
Severe grief changed from despair into hope-bearing restraint that keeps reunion imaginable and generates search.
Whitened eyes changed from a simple deficit into an epistemic and relational register: sight fails while inward knowing persists, then material contact with Yusuf restores seeing.
A secondary anger reading remains live, with later patience, no reproach, forgiveness, and mercy suggesting a possible nonretaliatory trajectory.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots formed one compact pressure mechanism while retaining competing relational, anger, epistemic, and hydraulic readings. Context did not collapse them: it activated mirrored concealment, chronic remembrance, search without despair, selective disclosure, and reversible sight, with several branch-distant images retained under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus does not decide whether the anger branch of ASF and KZM is active here or whether grief alone fills the containment.
The packet supports both bodily impairment and symbolic inscription but does not specify the physiology of whitening or sight loss.
The hydraulic eye, white patience-cloud, and standing-eye branches are analogical latent activations, not lexical substitutions.
The connection between Yaqub's restraint and Yusuf's later no-reproach mercy is retrospective and may be thematic rather than causal.
